dialogues.speaker: Lutz
dialogues.text: We can deliver letters to almost anyone in Fontaine, as long as you have the Coupons to pay for postage. Though we're practically doing it as charity, if I do say so myself.

dialogues.speaker: Lutz
dialogues.text: So would you like to send a letter? If so, please pay for postage first. And also, no queue jumping.
